title: Conference & Live Event Filming
description: Multi-camera stage filming combining cinema rigs, discreet remote PTZ setups, and live vision mixing, delivering master keynote recordings and rapid highlights across Cambridge and London.
seoTitle: Conference & Event Filming | Cambridge & London | FilmEditRun
seoDescription: Multi-camera conference filming and live event video capture across Cambridge and London. Full session keynote masters and fast 48h social highlight reels.
heroLead: Conferences spark ideas. We help you share them. Operating with agile crews across Cambridge and London, we capture every keynote and panel, delivering edited sessions and fast-turnaround social films while event momentum is at its peak.
breakdownHeading: Cinema rigs & remote PTZ. *Live vision mixing.*
breakdownBody: We combine manned cinema rigs for dynamic speaker tracking with discreet remote PTZ cameras operated from a single control desk. This captures multiple high-definition stage angles without crowding the room or blocking delegate sightlines, while on-site vision mixing integrates presentation slides with camera feeds in real time.

deliverables.title: On-Location Atmosphere & Networking
deliverables.description: Discreet roaming coverage capturing delegate networking, venue energy, and speaker soundbites, building a versatile asset library for future marketing and press.

deliverables.title: Live-Mixed Keynotes & Slide Feeds
deliverables.description: Multi-camera stage recording synchronized with presentation slide decks. Using our on-site live mix, we top-and-tail each keynote with your corporate branding for rapid publishing.

deliverables.title: 24–48h Wrap-Up Highlights & Reels
deliverables.description: High-energy 24–48h event wrap-up films cut to licensed soundtracks, delivered alongside captioned vertical (9:16) edits built for LinkedIn engagement.

ctaDescription: From multi-camera keynote stages in Cambridge and London to fast 24–48h highlight reels. Share your event dates and venue schedule for a dependable production brief.
